# Submission checklist

- [x] One paper-level thesis appears in title and abstract.
- [x] Gauge, metric, orientation, volume, and boundary conventions are stated.
- [x] Main results distinguish analytic proof from exact computation.
- [x] Every exact decimal from the exploratory stages is replaced by a
  rational identity.
- [x] Orientation correction is documented and regression-tested.
- [x] Classical ingredients are credited and novelty is stated conservatively.
- [x] No “first” or “previously unknown” claim is used.
- [x] No nonlinear physical-measure, continuum, or mass-gap implication is
  asserted.
- [x] Proof appendices contain the projection and KKT optimality logic.
- [x] Certificate generator, JSON output, and tests are included.
- [x] LaTeX build is clean and PDF metadata is present.
- [x] Representative PDF pages were visually inspected.
- [x] Code license and manuscript notice are present.
- [x] Portable archive and checksum are generated.
- [ ] Human author names, affiliations, acknowledgments, and conflicts are
  still required before submission.
- [ ] External expert citation-chain/novelty review is still required.
